description: Deterministic acceptance contract for governed temporal claims, authorization, provenance, conflicts, and atomic review operations.

cases.description: A current query returns the accepted replacement and not the claim it superseded.
A historical query returns the claim valid at that instant and not its later replacement.
A future-effective claim is scheduled rather than current and becomes selectable at its effective time.
A retired claim is absent from current truth but remains available for a date inside its validity interval.
An unresolved claim remains explicitly unresolved and cannot be represented as accepted truth.
Contradictory accepted claims visible to the caller produce an open conflict with authorized provenance.
Every accepted fixture claim resolves to an exact readable document version and excerpt.
Project claims require active project membership and the matching active project scope.
Restricted claims inherit source-document authorization and remain invisible without a readable source.
A caller cannot infer a conflict when the contradictory claim or its evidence is not authorized.
Applying a valid claim proposal creates the lifecycle transition, relationship, evidence, and audit event atomically.
A proposal with an invalid expected predecessor cannot partially mutate claim, relation, conflict, or audit state.
Rejecting a pending claim proposal records terminal review state and its audit event without changing truth.
